issue.label: package-submission
issue.instructions: Create an Issue with the package-submission label using your own authorized GitHub tool. Supply a complete Schema v2 record under the stable Canonical package JSON heading. Omit the notes heading when there are no notes. No token is accepted by this site.

timestamps: Preserve declared createdAt/updatedAt/publishedAt. New visual drafts include their actual metadata createdAt, not an invented upstream publication time. When all three timestamps are absent, the main Issue pipeline adds the actual GitHub Issue created_at as metadata createdAt so the record can enter dated projections.
validation: Browser checks the bundled Schema field constraints; CI performs final canonical and cross-file checks. Proposals target the packages branch, not main.

urlHandoff.fallback: Copy the complete JSON into the GitHub form. Do not truncate or encode package identity fields.
